Name: AiDialogue
Author: gaoqiao123
Description:
[b]AiDialogue｜自由对话、手机群聊与情绪配音[/b]
AiDialogue 让你可以在《星露谷物语》中，用自己的话与 NPC 交流。你可以当面聊天、通过手机发送消息、加入“星露谷大家庭”群聊，也可以开启语音，听见角色带着不同情绪回应。
NPC 会结合角色人设、相关记忆、人物关系和当前场景生成回答。你还可以修改角色设定、添加永久记忆，观看附近 NPC 相互交谈，让山谷的日常多一些新的互动。
[list]
[*][b]手机群聊与私聊[/b]：在皮埃尔商店花费 [b]2,500 金[/b]购买手机，即可打开星露谷风格的聊天界面。联系人根据游戏中可识别的 NPC 动态生成，头像使用角色默认立绘，手机物品图标会显示未读消息数量。群聊始终置顶，私聊联系人按最近收发消息的活动排序。[/*]
[*][b]更符合手机形式的回复[/b]：手机使用独立的聊天提示词，让 NPC 尽量以发消息的方式交流。群聊默认随机等待 [b]5–20 秒[/b]，私聊 [b]10–20 秒[/b]。群聊可连续交流；上一位发言者提及其他角色时，优先由被提及者接话。手机消息目前以文字显示。[/*]
[*][b]原版对话框中的自由聊天[/b]：与符合条件的 NPC 交互，由 AI 生成普通聊天的开场。点击原版对话框下方的“回复”，即可输入自己的回答、延续话题，不受原版每日固定台词数量限制。聊天、记忆和人设编辑支持光标移动、选区及复制粘贴。[/*]
[*][b]独立记忆与跨渠道同步[/b]：聊天记录按存档、玩家和 NPC 分别保存，同一角色的手机私聊与当面对话同步记忆。不同 NPC 的私人记忆相互隔离，群聊不会将私人聊天记录或永久记忆作为上下文。符合条件的历史默认每十五个游戏日压缩一次，记录较多时可提前触发。手动永久记忆支持 [b]0–1 的重要程度[/b]，不参与自动压缩。[/*]
[*][b]自定义角色人设[/b]：可以修改角色的姓名、背景、性格和说话方式，并选择应用于当前存档或所有存档。明确填写的设定优先于原有人设，未填写的部分由已有角色资料补充。人设与记忆分别管理。[/*]
[*][b]情绪配音与自动选声[/b]：可选的 AiDialogueVoice 组件支持为当面 AI 对话中的 NPC 回复配音，根据情绪标签调整表达。自动选声会参考角色已知的年龄段、性别和公开人设，匹配可用音色并保存绑定；也支持填写音色描述或手动指定 Voice ID。文字先显示，语音异步生成，语音失败不会阻止文字聊天。不同角色可能使用相同音色，这项功能不涉及声音克隆。[/*]
[*][b]NPC 自动交流[/b]：当前屏幕内符合条件的 NPC，可在默认十格范围内发起交流，每轮共 [b]2–5 句[/b]。参与者在本轮结束前不会加入其他对话，其他组合可以分别交流。背景气泡目前仅显示文字。[/*]
[*][b]立绘表情与特殊状态筛选[/b]：支持图片输入的模型可以读取实际加载的立绘，同时识别情绪和用途。日常聊天会避开沾泥、变身、特殊剧情动作等特殊或存疑帧，缺少对应图片时回退默认立绘。整套冬装、泳装或美化外观不会仅因服装不同而整体排除。结果按角色和图片指纹缓存；功能使用已有绘图，不生成或删除原图，也不改变原版剧情选图。分类仍可能误判。[/*]
[*][b]场景信息与扩展角色[/b]：每次请求重新读取当前地图、时间、天气、人物位置和附近角色。采用标准游戏数据的扩展 NPC 可以动态发现，并根据公开台词和人物资料生成独立人设。按需提供的公开人物简介帮助原版与扩展角色识别彼此，私人聊天和永久记忆不加入公开资料。[/*]
[*][b]可选好感变化与互动[/b]：可开启根据角色性格和交流内容评估好感变化的功能。普通变化为 [b]-5 至 +5[/b]，明确的重大冒犯可有更高扣分；没有每日累计评分上限，实际变化在左下角显示。每日首次成功显示的普通 AI 开场提供 [b]10 点基础聊天好感[/b]，替代原版的 20 点。普通送礼支持 AI 回应；符合条件的配偶或室友可使用独立的“亲吻／拥抱”按钮。[/*]
[*][b]灵活的接口配置[/b]：支持内置聊天服务商，以及自定义 OpenAI 兼容接口。填写 [b]Base URL、API Key[/b] 后，可以自动获取模型列表，也可以手动输入模型 ID。语音另行支持 [b]MiniMax、ElevenLabs 和本地 Qwen TTS[/b]。[/*]
[/list]首次使用：
[list=1]
[*]安装 [b]SMAPI 4.5.2 或更高版本[/b]。[/*]
[*]将三合一安装包中的
[code]AiDialogue[/code]、`AiDialogueVoice`、`AiDialoguePhone` 文件夹放入
[code]Stardew Valley/Mods/[/code]。[/*]
[*]通过 SMAPI 启动游戏并进入存档，打开 [b]Esc → 选项 → AI 对话设置[/b]。[/*]
[*]配置聊天服务商、API Key 和模型，启用 AI 对话并保存。[/*]
[*]如需配音，在语音设置中配置 TTS。云端服务需要相应的凭据和额度；本地 Qwen 需要按照
[code]AiDialogueVoice/local-runtime/[/code]中的说明安装依赖、下载模型并启动服务。[/*]
[*]前往皮埃尔商店购买手机，即可使用群聊与私聊。[/*]
[/list]模组自带设置页，[b]不需要 GMCM[/b]。聊天 Key 不一定能用于语音服务；立绘分类需要支持图片输入的模型。更新前请完全退出游戏，将发布文件合并覆盖到原文件夹，保留已有配置、人设、记忆和音色绑定，[b]不要先删除整个旧文件夹[/b]。
目前主要在 [b]Windows、Stardew Valley 1.6.15、SMAPI 4.5.2[/b] 环境测试。原版内容不需要 Content Patcher，扩展内容仍需安装其自身前置。动态发现不代表所有扩展剧情、特殊 NPC 或脚本交互均已完整适配，多人游戏也尚未完整验证。请遵守第三方作者对角色、台词和立绘的 AI 使用许可要求。
聊天、人设生成、记忆压缩、立绘分类、模型选声和云端配音都可能消耗 API 额度。回答准确性、角色一致性、分类结果、语音表现和等待时间取决于所选模型与服务。
配置、人设和记忆保存在本机 Mod 文件夹，API Key 以未加密形式保存。使用云端功能时，必要的文字、上下文或图片会发送给对应服务商。音色匹配使用公开角色资料与音色偏好，不读取玩家私人聊天或永久记忆。分享时请使用干净的发布包，避免直接分享使用过的整个 Mod 文件夹。
这是我第一次发布模组，也仍在学习。最初和朋友一起测试时，我觉得这些交流很有趣，希望把这份体验分享给更多玩家。欢迎反馈问题、建议和兼容性情况。
[b]下载交流与反馈 QQ 群：1098517417[/b]

[b]AiDialogue — Conversations, Phone Messaging and Expressive Voices[/b]
AiDialogue lets you talk to Stardew Valley’s NPCs in your own words. Meet them in person, send private phone messages, join the Stardew Valley Family group chat, or enable optional speech to hear their replies.
Responses use character information, relevant memories, relationships and current game context. You can customize personas, add permanent memories and watch nearby NPCs exchange speech bubbles.
[list]
[*][b]Phone messaging and group chat:[/b] Buy a phone from Pierre for [b]2,500g[/b]. Its Stardew-style messenger discovers eligible NPC contacts dynamically, uses their default portraits as avatars and displays an unread count on the inventory icon. The family group stays pinned, while private contacts are ordered by recent sent and received messages.[/*]
[*][b]Messages written for a phone:[/b] Dedicated prompts encourage short, conversational messages rather than face-to-face narration. Default reply delays are randomized between [b]5–20 seconds for group chat[/b] and [b]10–20 seconds for private messages[/b]. Group conversations can continue between NPCs, with mentioned characters prioritized for the next reply. Phone messages are currently text-only.[/*]
[*][b]Free-form conversations in the native UI:[/b] Interact with an eligible NPC for an AI-generated opening, then click [b]Reply[/b] beneath the original dialogue box to type your response. Ordinary conversations can continue beyond vanilla’s daily dialogue limit. Editors support caret movement, selection, copy and paste.[/*]
[*][b]Separate memories with phone/in-person synchronization:[/b] Conversation history is separated by save, player and NPC. Private phone messages and in-person conversations synchronize memories for the same character. Other NPCs’ private histories remain isolated, and group prompts do not include private conversations or permanent memories. Eligible histories are compressed after fifteen in-game days by default, or earlier when records become large. Manual permanent memories support importance weights from [b]0 to 1[/b] and remain outside automatic compression.[/*]
[*][b]Custom personas:[/b] Define a character’s name, background, personality and speech style for one save or all saves. Explicit custom settings take priority, while existing character information fills unspecified details. Personas and memories are managed separately.[/*]
[*][b]Emotion-aware speech and automatic voice matching:[/b] The optional AiDialogueVoice component voices NPC replies in face-to-face AI conversations. Emotion labels guide delivery, while voice matching considers the character’s known age group, gender and public persona. You can describe a preferred voice or specify a Voice ID manually. Text appears first and speech is generated asynchronously; speech failures do not block text chat. Characters may share voices. This feature does not clone voices.[/*]
[*][b]NPC-to-NPC conversations:[/b] Eligible visible NPCs can exchange [b]2–5 total lines per round[/b] within a default range of ten tiles. Participants remain reserved until their round ends, while other pairs can converse separately. Background speech bubbles are currently text-only.[/*]
[*][b]Portrait expressions with special-state filtering:[/b] A vision-capable model classifies both emotion and everyday suitability in the actual loaded artwork. Ordinary AI chat avoids special or uncertain frames, such as temporary mud, transformations or scene-specific actions, and falls back to default art when necessary. Consistent winter, beach or overhaul outfits should remain usable. Results are cached by NPC and texture fingerprint. The feature uses existing art, creates no new portraits and leaves scripted event portrait selection unchanged. Classification can still be wrong.[/*]
[*][b]Live context and expanded characters:[/b] Requests refresh locations, time, weather, positions and nearby characters. Standard data-driven custom NPCs can be discovered dynamically, with individual personas generated from their public dialogue and metadata. Relevant public profiles help vanilla and expanded characters recognize one another without sharing private conversations or permanent memories.[/*]
[*][b]Optional friendship changes and interactions:[/b] Dialogue scoring considers character and context. Ordinary changes stay between [b]-5 and +5[/b], with stronger penalties reserved for clear major offenses. Scoring has no daily cumulative cap, and notifications show applied changes. The first successful ordinary AI greeting each day grants a [b]10-point base reward[/b], replacing vanilla’s 20 points. Ordinary gifts can receive AI reactions, and eligible spouses or roommates have separate [b]Kiss/Hug[/b] controls.[/*]
[*][b]Flexible services:[/b] Use a built-in chat provider or a custom OpenAI-compatible service with a [b]Base URL, API key and automatically retrieved or manually entered model ID[/b]. Speech separately supports [b]MiniMax, ElevenLabs and local Qwen TTS[/b].[/*]
[/list]To get started:
[list=1]
[*]Install [b]SMAPI 4.5.2 or later[/b].[/*]
[*]Extract the
[code]AiDialogue[/code],
[code]AiDialogueVoice[/code]and
[code]AiDialoguePhone[/code]folders from the complete package into
[code]Stardew Valley/Mods/[/code].[/*]
[*]Launch through SMAPI, load a save and open [b]Esc → Options → AI Dialogue Settings[/b].[/*]
[*]Configure your chat provider, API key and model, then enable AI dialogue and save.[/*]
[*]For speech, configure a supported TTS service. Cloud services require their own credentials and quota. For local Qwen, follow the instructions in
[code]AiDialogueVoice/local-runtime/[/code]to install dependencies, download models and start the local service.[/*]
[*]Buy a phone from Pierre to access private messaging and group chat.[/*]
[/list][b]GMCM is not required.[/b] A chat API key does not necessarily provide speech access. Portrait classification requires a model that accepts images. Fully close the game before updating, merge release files into the existing folders and preserve your settings, personas, memories and voice bindings. [b]Do not delete the old folders first.[/b]
Testing primarily covers [b]Windows, Stardew Valley 1.6.15 and SMAPI 4.5.2[/b]. Content Patcher is unnecessary for vanilla content; expansions still require their own prerequisites. Dynamic discovery does not establish complete compatibility with every expansion, scripted interaction or custom-code NPC. Full multiplayer compatibility remains unverified. Please respect third-party authors’ AI-use permissions.
Chatting, persona generation, memory compression, portrait classification, model-based voice selection and cloud speech may consume API quota. Accuracy, character consistency, visual classification, speech delivery and response times depend on the selected models and services.
Settings, personas and memories are stored locally inside the mod folders. API keys are stored without encryption. Enabled cloud features send the necessary text, context or images to the relevant provider. Voice matching uses public character information and voice preferences without accessing private player conversations or permanent memories. Share clean release packages rather than your used mod folders.
This is my first published mod, and I’m still learning. I enjoyed trying these conversations with friends and wanted to share the experience. Bug reports, suggestions and compatibility feedback are welcome.
